brief:
An Israeli settler assaulted a Palestinian child during an attack on a family east of Yatta, with video footage documenting the incident, Al Jazeera English reported. The footage shows the settler shouting at the child before the physical assault.

The attack occurred in an area where settler violence against Palestinians has been documented. Details of injuries sustained or the circumstances leading to the confrontation were not immediately specified.
dek: An Israeli settler was filmed shouting at and assaulting a Palestinian child during an attack on a family east of Yatta.
title: Israeli settler assaults Palestinian child in video footage
